variants.prompt: On a moonlit beach, a stunning woman in a barely-there bikini lounges on a weathered driftwood log, her long, tanned legs crossed as she provocatively toys with a set of sex aids. The cool, salty breeze tousles her golden hair as she looks directly at the camera with a sultry, come-hither gaze, the soft, grainy texture of the sand and the distant crashing of waves creating a sense of a private, secluded encounter.
